nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri desktop shell library: registers the HTTP plugin and exposes two health-check commands (ping, get_app_version) while the React SPA talks to the remote API directly.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using #[tauri::command] attribute macros and generate_handler! to expose IPC commands to the webview.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Builds and runs the Tauri application, wiring the HTTP plugin and the invoke handler for ping and get_app_version.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Binary entry point for the Tauri desktop app; suppresses the Windows console in release builds and delegates to madar_dashboard_lib::run.

nodes.name: tauri.conf.json
nodes.summary: Tauri 2 app configuration: product identity, dev/build commands wired to Vite, a 1400x900 main window, a strict CSP allowing the Madar API and Google Maps, and bundle icons for all targets.

nodes.name: lib.ts
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder module for the QR feature; QR generator pages cache no server state so no invalidation helpers are needed.

nodes.name: fontsource.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declarations for @fontsource and @fontsource-variable packages so their CSS-only side-effect imports type-check under TypeScript 6.

nodes.name: ar.json
nodes.summary: Arabic translation catalog for i18next with ~75 top-level namespaces covering the whole dashboard, ordering and tracking surfaces; RTL counterpart of en.json.

nodes.name: en.json
nodes.summary: English translation catalog for i18next with ~75 top-level namespaces (app, common, nav, orders, menu, staff, reports, etc.) used across the dashboard and customer surfaces.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Source of truth for the visual system: Tailwind v4 imports, light/dark OKLCH design tokens (teal brand), @theme mapping, base layer, custom utilities, reduced-motion rules, and Leaflet map pin and onboarding confetti animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Tailwind v4 CSS-first config (@theme inline, @utility, @custom-variant) with OKLCH color tokens and a class-based dark variant.

nodes.name: setup.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest global setup that registers jest-dom matchers for component tests.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Main Vite build config for the dashboard: TanStack Router file routing with code splitting, React SWC, Tailwind, Brotli/gzip precompression, the @ alias, dep pre-bundling (including CJS exceljs), and manualChunks vendor splitting.
nodes.languageNotes: manualChunks partitions node_modules into named vendor chunks (chart, form, router, query, motion, i18n, ui, react, exceljs, zip).

nodes.name: vite.get.config.ts
nodes.summary: Separate Vite build for the standalone marketing landing (get.madar-pos.cloud) with get.html as entry, a dev SPA fallback plugin, and no TanStack router or dashboard code.

nodes.name: vite.order.config.ts
nodes.summary: Separate Vite build for the customer ordering/tracking surface with its own HTML entry and output dir, excluding admin dashboard code from the bundle.

nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest configuration merged onto the main Vite config, enabling jsdom, globals, and the jest-dom setup file.
